name: mirage
text:
Released v1.0.39: the GitHub engine now closes its BoltOdds, Kalshi and SX sockets cleanly whenever a job ends or is cancelled, and a 'too many concurrent connections' close no longer marks your BoltOdds key as refused.
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.39
Still to check: that Stop All and per-API toggles close sockets on every path (BC1/BC2).
